RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r4.claim: The womb is a secure place where the material from which a child forms remains and becomes established, unlike material that does not produce a child.
RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r4.anchor: فجعلناه فى قرار مكين } وهو الرحم ، لأن ما يخلق منه الولد لا بد وأن يثبت في الرحم ويتمكن

STUDYQURAN:77:20/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:77:20/r2.speaker: IK and Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:77:20/r2.claim: IK and Ṭ identify the secure dwelling place as the womb.
STUDYQURAN:77:20/r2.anchor: The secure dwelling place is a reference to the womb (IK, Ṭ)

TAB-FULL:v23p594#3/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p594#3/r3.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p594#3/r3.claim: God placed the weak fluid in a secure, stable place in which it settles: the womb.
TAB-FULL:v23p594#3/r3.anchor: فجعلنا الماء المهين في رحم استقر فيها فتمكن

TAB-FULL:v23p594#3/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p594#3/r4.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v23p594#3/r4.claim: Mujāhid identifies the secure place as the womb.
TAB-FULL:v23p594#3/r4.anchor: عن ابن أبي نجيح، عن مجاهد، قوله: {في قرار مكين} [المؤمنون: 13]

TABATABAI:77:16-24/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r1.claim: This passage presents proofs of God's sole lordship and the Day of Decision, recalls punishment for deniers and blessings for the pious, and reproaches those arrogant toward worship and revelation.
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r1.anchor: بيان حجج دالة على توحد الربوبية تقضي بوجود يوم الفصل الذي فيه جزاء المكذبين به

TABATABAI:77:16-24/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r8.speaker: author
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r8.claim: The secure resting place is the womb.

TABATABAI:77:16-24/r12.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r12.speaker: author
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r12.claim: Creation and the governance of human development prove sole lordship; lordship entails the creatures' submission and obligation, which requires recompense on a Day of Decision.
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r12.anchor: الربوبية تستوجب خضوع المربوبين لساحتها وهو الدين المتضمن للتكليف

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r1.claim: The verse parallels the account that God made human offspring from an extract of lowly water in 32:8, also discussed in Surat al-Muʾminun.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p88#2/r1.anchor: وهذا كقوله: {ثم جعل نسله من سلالة من ماء مهين (8)}

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:77:10-24/r10.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:77:10-24/r10.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:77:10-24/r10.claim: The secure resting place is the womb.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:77:10-24/r10.anchor: { فجعلناه في قرار مكين } أي: الرحم.

ELMALILI:77:21-28/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:77:21-28/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:77:21-28/r1.claim: The secure resting place is the womb.
ELMALILI:77:21-28/r1.anchor: “Karâr-ı mekîn” sağlam oturaklı karargâh, yani rahim.

ELMALILI:77:21-28/r6.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:77:21-28/r6.speaker: author
ELMALILI:77:21-28/r6.claim: The womb and the earth show that before and after birth, through life and death, people are enclosed by their need for a dwelling and remain held in God’s power.
ELMALILI:77:21-28/r6.anchor: Yukarıda قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍ, burada كِفَات insanların gerek doğmadan evvel ve gerek doğduktan sonra her tavrında vatan ihtiyâcına

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r1.claim: The “despised water” is sperm, the “secure place” is the womb, and the “known term” is the period of pregnancy.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r1.anchor: “Önemsenmeyen bir su”dan maksat sperm (bk. Kıyâmet 75/37), onun yerleştirildiği “sağlam yer” ana rahmi, “belli bir süre” ise hamilelik dönemidir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r2.claim: Human origins and development provide a striking example of God’s creative power and show the baselessness of denying resurrection.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r2.anchor: Âyetlerde insanın hangi maddeden ve nasıl yaratıldığı açıklanarak Allah’ın neleri yapmaya, yaratmaya kadir olduğuna dair en dikkate değer örneklerden biri ortaya konmuş

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r4.claim: God formed humans from simple semen, developed them through stages in the womb, endowed them with material and spiritual abilities, and made them Earth’s most perfect beings.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r4.anchor: Allah insanı basit, bir sudan yani meniden yaratmış, ana rahminde onu çeşitli aşamalardan geçirerek

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r5.claim: Despite these priceless gifts, humanity is ungrateful and disobeys God; the surah has warned since verse 18, “Woe on that day to the deniers.”
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r5.anchor: Ama insanoğlu nankörlük ederek kendisine paha biçilmez nimetleri lutfeden Allah’a isyan etmektedir. İşte bundan dolayı 18.âyetten başlamak üzere

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r6.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r6.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r6.claim: The one who created a perfect human from simple water is also able to resurrect that human after death.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r6.anchor: Basit bir sudan böyle mükemmel insanı yaratıp meydana getiren yaratıcı kudret onu öldükten sonra diriltmeye de kadirdir.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p109/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p109/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p109/r1.claim: Human physical structure and stages of creation display God's power, providence, and wisdom; the Creator can readily recreate people, so resurrection is certain and its deniers doomed.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p109/r1.anchor: The purpose of this mention is that man’s own creation bears testimony that re-creating him is not at all difficult for His Creator.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r4.claim: After historical evidence, the passage turns to man's creation as evidence for resurrection and the Day of Judgement.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r4.anchor: The previous verses presented historical evidence. These verses present evidence drawn from the creation of man.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r5.claim: The Qur'an argues that judgement is possible because humans were created from fluid, required by God's power, wisdom, and creativity, entailed by the provision system, and supported by innate awareness of good and evil.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r5.anchor: from the creation of man in various ways

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r6.claim: The initial creation of man from mud and a drop of fluid proves that resurrection is possible.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r6.anchor: By referring to man’s creation from mud and from a drop of fluid, evidence is drawn on the fact that the Day of Judgement is a possible phenomenon.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r7.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r7.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r7.claim: The signs of God's power, wisdom, and creativity in making man entail that the Day of Judgement must come.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r7.anchor: The signs of God’s power, wisdom and creativity in the creation of man entail that a Day of Judgement must come.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r8.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r8.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r8.claim: The elaborate system established to sustain man also entails that a Day of Judgement must come.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r8.anchor: The tremendous system for man’s sustenance elaborately set up by the Almighty also entails that a Day of Judgement must come.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r9.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r9.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r9.claim: Man's innate awareness of good and evil is further evidence that a Day of Judgement must come.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r9.anchor: The innate awareness about good and evil found in a person bears evidence that a Day of Judgement must come.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r1.claim: The initial creation of man from an insignificant fluid answers deniers who wonder how God could recreate people after their bones decay; what is already evident makes resurrection possible.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r1.anchor: when no one can deny such an obvious reality as man being created from an insignificant fluid

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r4.claim: The verse points to the fluid's remarkable development through successive stages; qarār means a place of rest, here the womb appointed for this purpose.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r4.anchor: the fluid as it passes through various stages

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r5.claim: Qarār can mean rest or a place of rest; here it means the womb as the appointed place of safety.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r5.anchor: Here it refers to the latter

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r6.claim: When makīn describes a place, it means secure from hazards, dangers, and undue intervention.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r6.anchor: secure from hazards, dangers and undue interventions.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p125/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p125/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p125/r1.claim: The preceding argument invokes signs within human beings and in the external world; the ensuing passage makes the unseen punishment vivid to the deniers.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p125/r1.anchor: through the signs found in the world inside man and those found outside him.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p375/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p375/r8.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p375/r8.claim: The secure resting place is the womb.

ALUSI-FULL:v29p174#5/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p174#5/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p174#5/r1.claim: The secure resting place is the womb.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p305/r9.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p305/r9.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p305/r9.claim: The secure lodging is the womb.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p305/r9.anchor: فجعلناه في قرار مكين} يعني الرحم.

BAYDAWI-FULL:77:17-24/r8.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:77:17-24/r8.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:77:17-24/r8.claim: The secure place is the womb.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r3.claim: God places the drop in the womb, a secure receptacle protected from air and other harms, for development through successive stages.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r3.anchor: أي محفوظ مما يفسده من الهواء وغيره ومددنا ذلك لأجل التطوير في أطوار الخلقة والتدوير في أدوار الصنعة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r1.claim: Describing the stages of creation also supports the possibility of resurrection, since overwhelming power is unable to be thwarted; the following praise reinforces this.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r1.anchor: تفصيل لكيفية الخلق على سبيل الإدماج مع مناسبته لأن له دخلا في تبيين إمكان الإعادة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r2.claim: Qarar is a place of settling and remaining.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r3.claim: Makin describes a firmly established place, from the root for being settled and secure; the intended resting place is the womb.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r3.anchor: و { مكين } : صفة ل { قرار } ، أي مكان متمكن في ذلك فهو فعيل من مكن مكانة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r4.claim: Calling the abstract resting place firmly established is a rational metaphor; the estimate is firmly established within it, namely in the womb.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p431/r4.anchor: ووصف القرار بالمكين على طريقة المجاز العقلي ، أي مكين الحال والمستقر فيه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p418#2/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p418#2/r8.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p418#2/r8.claim: قرار مكين means the womb or a woman's abdomen.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p418#2/r8.anchor: و «القرار المكين» : الرحم أو بطن المرأة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#4/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#4/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#4/r1.claim: The secure resting place is the womb.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#4/r1.anchor: فجعلناه في قرار مكين يعني الرحم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p298/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p298/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p298/r4.claim: God gathers the male and female fluid in the womb, a place made to hold and protect what is deposited in it.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p298/r4.anchor: يعني: جمعناه في الرحم، وهو قرار الماء من الرجل والمرأة، والرحم معد لذلك، حافظ لما أودع فيه من الماء.

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r9.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r9.speaker: وهب بن منبه
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r9.claim: The secure resting place is the mother’s womb, where the fetus is protected from heat and cold.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r9.anchor: قاله وهب بن منبه في رحم أمه لا يؤذيه حر ولا برد

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r10.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r10.speaker: الكلبي
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r10.claim: Makin means secure: the fluid does not flow back out or spread through the body, so it remains there.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r10.anchor: مكين حريز لا يعود فيخرج ولا يبث في الجسد فيدوم , قاله الكلبي

MUJAHID:v2p715#2/r1.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p715#2/r1.speaker: مجاهد
MUJAHID:v2p715#2/r1.claim: Mujahid identifies the secure place as the womb.
MUJAHID:v2p715#2/r1.anchor: عن ابن أبي نجيح عن مجاهد في قوله ﴿ فجعلناه في قرار مكين ﴾ قال يعني في الرحم

MUQATIL:77:8-23/r14.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:77:8-23/r14.speaker: author
MUQATIL:77:8-23/r14.claim: The water is lodged securely in the womb.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p307#15/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p307#15/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p307#15/r1.claim: “It” refers to the water, which God placed in a secure repository: the womb.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p307#15/r1.anchor: مكين مقر يتمكن فيه وهو الرحم ومحل

QURTUBI-FULL:77:20-23/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:77:20-23/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:77:20-23/r3.claim: The secure place is the womb.
QURTUBI-FULL:77:20-23/r3.anchor: أي في مكان حريز وهو الرحم
